brief:
DAWN responded to President Trump's announcement that the United States will terminate its $4 billion in annual military aid to Israel by year's end. The organization's statement, issued November 3, 2026, came as Trump cited budget pressures for the policy reversal.

The aid cutoff represents a reversal of decades of U.S. military support for Israel. Trump had not previously indicated plans to halt assistance to the country.
dek: (Washington, D.C., November 3, 2026) - In response to President Trump’s announcement that the United States will end its $4 billion in annual military aid to Israel at the end of this year, DAWN issues the following statement:…
title: Trump ends U.S. military aid to Israel, citing budget concerns
